messages:
alex: Heads-up: SAST pipeline started failing audit checks after RBAC tweak. Root 6987654321.
ria: Saw that. Failure is on scanner service account decrypt against KMS: permission_denied.
ops-oncall: Looking at audit logs: grant for svc-sast expired ~30m before run, but KMS logs show a denied decrypt request, not a missing key. Possibly IAM role change.
policy-bot: Note: policy change PR #3421 reduced iam:Decrypt on the scanner SA to a conditions-based binding.
alex: Can we short-term re-grant decrypt for nightly runs and record an audit event? Compliance wants chain-of-custody for fixes.
ria: propose: ephemeral grant flow + audit stamp: 1) request ephemeral decrypt binding for 2h 2) run SAST 3) revoke binding and log the grant_id to SAST report.
ops-oncall: I can add a script to orchestrate grant->run->revoke and push audit entries to keystore-audit (retention 90d).
policy-bot: Current retention is 90d. To meet compliance (1yr), file SDLC-4620.
alex: For triage, attach grant_id to failing findings so we can trace which runs had the temporary grant. Ria, can you add that to the scanner output?
ria: yes, will add grant_id and k8s node metadata. Opening PR shortly.
ops-oncall: I'll also create a low-priority alert for repeated decrypt_denied spikes and add a runbook step to request ephemeral grant.
alex: thanks. After PRs land, let's do a canary run on sast-beta and confirm audit entries show up.
